main_text.head: EXIMIO VIRO ET AMICO SVO SVM-ME DILIGENDO ET OBSER-uando GVLIELMO SCOTO Ab Elie, HENRICVS CHARTERIS S. & G. per Christum.
main_text.p: VANTI interfit iuuentu-tem cum humanioribus studiis, & politiori litera-tura, vna etiam imbibere eminentiam illam cogni-tionis Christi, tu optimè nofti, Vir exi-mie, qui sæpiusculè solitus es prædicare sordete omnia ista humana, humanam prudentiam, industriam, erudition em, artes etiam ipsas & scientias, imò noxia esse & exitiosa, si à cognitione Christi separentur. Quo mihi videntur fœlicio-res, & non Deo tantùm, sed & Præce-ptoribus magis obligati, qui ab ijs ... cum Apostolo loquar, didicerur.

page.notes: Woodcut initial "V" (of Vanti) is decorative; the initial is rendered as "VANTI" with the large letter joined. The right margin note at the end of the text is a marginal mark, not legible as words. Several words in the last line are damaged by the printed ornament and are partly illegible; "ijs" and "didicerur" are doubtful. Printed text has ligatures and "s" long s, rendered as plain s; "scientias" is retained as printed with long s in source.
